premises.statement: The opportunity model may generate a new load timestamp instead of preserving the staging model's load timestamp.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: cast(current_timestamp as timestamp with time zone) as _dbt_loaded_at
premises.alternative: The contract describes this column as "Model load timestamp from stg_salesforce__opportunity" and requires "emit all source columns as-is".
premises.reason: The generated timestamp describes the mart execution rather than the upstream load.

premises.statement: A NULL is_closed value must not qualify an opportunity as Pipeline in the enhanced model.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: when is_closed is false and lower(forecast_category) in ('pipeline','forecast','bestcase') then 'Pipeline'
premises.alternative: The contract's status column description says "Pipeline if is_closed is not true", and its is_closed description says "NULL treated as not closed in status derivation"; however, another passage says NULL booleans result in Other.
premises.reason: The implementation chooses one side of conflicting NULL-status requirements.

premises.statement: The daily opportunity history status rules apply independently of NULL values in inputs not needed by the matching branch.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: case when is_won is true then 'Won' ... when is_closed is false and lower(forecast_category) in ('pipeline','forecast','bestcase') then 'Pipeline'
premises.alternative: The contract also states "If is_won, is_closed, or forecast_category is NULL, none of the first three conditions apply and status is Other".
premises.reason: Rows with partially missing status inputs can receive Won, Lost, or Pipeline instead of Other.

premises.statement: Passing through INTEGER timing fields satisfies the enhanced opportunity model's BIGINT timing-field requirements.
premises.alternative: The staging contract declares days_since_created and days_to_close as INTEGER, while the enhanced model declares both as BIGINT.
premises.reason: Direct projection retains the upstream types rather than producing the declared mart schema.

premises.statement: The staging contact table contains at most one row for each contact_id.
premises.reason: Repeated source contact IDs would violate the mart's unique contact_id test even without join multiplication.
